result.summary: Rework 1 verified independently, not trusted from the rework's self-report. (a) Section 1.1: wrote a fresh probe from scratch (scratch/recheck_1_1.exs, not copied from either prior probe script), run as `PATH="$HOME/.asdf/shims:$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" WASMEX_BUILD=true mix run --no-start scratch/recheck_1_1.exs` against the same installed wasmex 0.15.1. Result: `Wasmex.Memory.size(store, memory)` returns the bare integer `65536` -- `{:ok, 65536}` task result confirms the raw call itself yields `65536` (Task.yield wraps it in `{:ok, _}`, the inner value is the bare integer, not a nested tuple). Then explicitly attempted `{:ok, _size} = Wasmex.Memory.size(store, memory)` inside a supervised task: it raised `** (MatchError) no match of right hand side value: 65536`, task exited `{:badmatch, 65536}`. This exactly matches the corrected transcript in section 1.1 (`Wasmex.Memory.size(store, memory) #=> 65536`) and directly falsifies the original blocker's `{:ok, 65536}` claim. Section 1.1 is now correct. (b) Grepped every `Memory.size` reference in the design doc (lines 65-79 section 1.1, 226/243 section 2, 293/323/332/342/374 section 3) -- every one of the section 2 and section 4-adjacent usages is a bare assignment (`memory_size = Wasmex.Memory.size(store, memory)`), never a tuple destructure; no lingering tagged-tuple assumption anywhere in the document. (c) Diffed the full design doc between the pre-rework commit (bf071de) and the rework commit (a2f4d30): the only changes are the new 'Rework pass 1' paragraph appended after the scratch-script list in section 0, and section 1.1's heading/transcript/added correction note. Sections 1.2-1.6, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 are byte-for-byte unchanged from the version this validator already passed in the original Step 1b -- nothing was altered, so nothing could have been damaged. `mix letflow.lint_handoffs` run: 0 new violations across 1244 handoff files (pre-existing grandfathered violations unrelated to this run, traced to ISS-0190). REQ-168's design is APPROVED -- gate cleared, ready to advance to Step 2 (ELIXIR-DEV implementation).
